derivation: from G1223 (διά) and a derivative of G2478 (ἰσχυρός);
def: to stout it through, i.e. asservate

occurrences.text: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilean.
And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
